Photorealistic cutout of BACK HALF ONLY of empty premium florist bouquet wrapping, cream ivory tissue inside and muted blush matte paper outside. NO flowers, stems, ribbon, bow or front flap. Front-facing, soft daylight upper left. Square transparent canvas. Composition registration is critical: top 25% of canvas entirely transparent. Broad loose asymmetrical pointed paper wings extend from x10% to90% at y35%; folded rear paper opens upward to receive flowers. Back panel narrows toward a pinched waist centered at x50%, y82%; lower paper tapers to y94%. Real delicate paper fibers, fine irregular folds, restrained highlights. This is an independent rear layer for compositing flowers OVER it, not a complete bouquet image. Genuine transparent alpha background, no background color, halo, cast shadow, logos or text.

Photorealistic cutout of FRONT HALF ONLY of premium empty florist bouquet wrapping, muted cream/blush matte paper. NO rear paper wings, flowers, stems, ribbons or bows. Front-facing, soft daylight upper left. Square transparent canvas registered for layered bouquet composition. Entire top 56% of canvas MUST be completely transparent. Visible object starts at x22%, y57% on left and x78%,y55% on right: two overlapping paper flaps create a shallow irregular V-shaped open upper rim dipping to x50%,y65%. Folded front flaps narrow into pinched waist at x50%,y82%, then short tapered paper tails end at y94%. Natural fine paper texture and creases, subtle realistic depth, soft premium ivory/blush color. This is ONLY lower front paper covering stem bottoms; no complete enclosing back cone. Genuine transparent alpha background everywhere around object, no glow, halo, floor, shadow, text, watermark.
